title: A dot-product bound from separate growth-minimizing bases
summary: For every finite $P\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ we prove $|\{p\cdot q: p,q\in P\}|\gg |P|^{199/295}$, with an absolute constant and no logarithmic loss, where $199/295 = 2/3+7/885$. This improves the bound $2/3+7/1425$ of Kokkinos (arXiv:2502.12727), which in turn had improved the first superthreshold bound of Hanson, Roche-Newton, and Senger.
